claims: Inter Miami CF officially opened Nu Stadium at Miami Freedom Park on April 4, 2026.
Inter Miami CF drew 2-2 against Austin FC at Nu Stadium at Miami Freedom Park on April 4, 2026.
Nu Stadium at Miami Freedom Park is located near Miami International Airport.
Nu Stadium at Miami Freedom Park has 26,700 seats.
Nu Stadium at Miami Freedom Park is part of the 131-acre Miami Freedom Park development.
Miami Freedom Park development is 131 acres.
Nu Stadium at Miami Freedom Park features a "Leo Messi Stand".
Nu Stadium at Miami Freedom Park features panoramic views of the city.
The Miami Freedom Park development features retail.
The Miami Freedom Park development features entertainment.
The Miami Freedom Park site includes a 58-acre public park.
The Miami Freedom Park site includes a 1-mile walking/bicycle trail.
The Miami Freedom Park site includes a hotel.
The Miami Freedom Park site includes office space.
Nu Stadium at Miami Freedom Park is a $1 billion venue.
The Miami Freedom Park project is part of a broader $1 billion development.
Inter Miami CF previously played at DRV PNK Stadium in Fort Lauderdale.
Nu Stadium at Miami Freedom Park provides a long-term home for Inter Miami CF
